scope: Actual local video frame decode/inference path; not classifier quality or browser codec acceptance.
implementation: MP4/WebM is decoded through a muted local HTMLVideoElement backed only by an already fetched or locally decrypted Blob URL, never a sender-controlled remote video URL. No demux dependency or remote classifier was added.

Each file is bounded to 12 MiB, 120 seconds, five deterministic frames and four million pixels per frame. Metadata, seek, bitmap decode and classification share a 30-second abort deadline; late bitmaps are closed and video/Blob resources released.

Video metadata records real sampled frame counts and duration, not invented total frame counts. Negative-only video samples stay uncertain. Combined animated-raster/video metadata is limited to four attachments; single decoded-frame worker responses cannot claim sampling metadata.
The media gate shows both video and animation coverage warnings for mixed attachments. Unsupported codecs, long or malformed videos and incomplete decoding remain unclassified.
